## Data Management Tasks

The Data Section's ongoing responsibilities include the validation, processing, maintenance and dissemination of fisheries datasets, alongside the development of reporting tools, reference data and information systems. This section will be completed once the verified record of 2026 developments is available.

**Reporting forms, standards and validation.** *To complete: revisions to statistical and ROS reporting forms, data validators, code lists and reporting guidance; distinguish released tools from work in progress.*

**Databases, processing and dissemination.** *To complete: progress on PostgreSQL/PostGIS migration, e-MARIS, ROS databases, reproducible processing and publication of datasets and reference data.*

**IOTC website and online services.** *To complete: migration to FAO infrastructure, revised web pages and access to reporting guidance and data products.*

**Projects supporting data-related activities.** *To complete: EC1350 and SWIOP scope, data components, implementation status and verified 2026 deliverables.*

**Consultancies.** *To complete: concise account of consultant contributions and reference to a list of consultants in Appendix I or a separate table.*
